verdict.rationale: Ente's live llms.txt states its apps and server are open source, a community user thanks Ente for releasing Auth as open source, and the docs link to a public GitHub repository (github.com/ente/ente). The evidence never names the license or links the Auth app's own source tree, so the 'open license' part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: the specific open-source license named in evidence, a first-party link to the Auth app's source repository, and independent confirmation of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
